title: Course Master – Sync Data – New Record Synced to BO After Manual Sync
description: Sync – Manual Sync (Scenario) – Create a new Course Master in SF, trigger Sync Data, and verify the record appears in the Back Office.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
- A Course Master SyncNew_TC has been created in SF (Name = SyncNew_TC, PID = sync_new, Code = sync_new)
- Logged in to the Back Office as HQ Staff
- Auto-sync has not yet run since the record was created
steps_actions:
1. "In SF, confirm SyncNew_TC is visible in the Course Master list"
2. "In BO, search for SyncNew_TC"
3. "In SF Course Master list, click Sync Data"
4. "Wait for the sync to complete"
5. "In BO, search for SyncNew_TC again"
steps_result:
1. "Record exists in SF"
2. "Record is NOT yet visible in BO"
3. "Sync is triggered; a progress indicator or confirmation message is shown"
4. "Sync completes without error"
5. "SyncNew_TC is now visible in BO with matching Name, Course Code, and Partner Internal Id"

title: Course Master – Sync Data – Updated Record Reflected in BO After Manual Sync
description: Sync – Manual Sync (Scenario) – Update a Course Master in SF, trigger Sync Data, and verify the updated values are reflected in the Back Office.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
- A Course Master SyncUpdate_TC exists and has already been synced to BO
- Logged in to the Back Office as HQ Staff
steps_actions:
1. "In BO, confirm the current Name of the synced record"
2. "In SF, edit SyncUpdate_TC and change the Name"
3. "In BO, confirm BO still shows the old name"
4. "In SF Course Master list, click Sync Data"
5. "In BO, search for SyncUpdated_TC"
steps_result:
1. "BO shows Name = SyncUpdate_TC"
2. "Name updated to SyncUpdated_TC in SF"
3. "BO still displays SyncUpdate_TC (not yet updated)"
4. "Sync triggered and completes without error"
5. "BO now displays the updated Name = SyncUpdated_TC"

title: Course Master – Sync Data – Deleted Record Removed from BO After Manual Sync
description: Sync – Manual Sync (Scenario) – Delete a Course Master in SF, trigger Sync Data, and verify the record is removed from the Back Office.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
- A Course Master SyncDelete_TC exists and is already synced to BO
- Logged in to the Back Office as HQ Staff
steps_actions:
1. "In SF, confirm SyncDelete_TC is visible in both SF and BO"
2. "In SF, delete SyncDelete_TC"
3. "In BO, confirm SyncDelete_TC is still visible"
4. "In SF Course Master list, click Sync Data"
5. "In BO, search for SyncDelete_TC"
steps_result:
1. "Record present in both systems"
2. "Record is deleted from SF"
3. "Record still present in BO (sync not yet triggered)"
4. "Sync triggered and completes without error"
5. "Record is no longer visible in BO"

title: Course Master – Auto Sync – New Record Synced to BO After Configured Interval Elapses
description: Sync – Auto Sync (State Transition) – Verify a new Course Master created in SF is automatically synced to BO after the org-configured interval elapses without any manual trigger.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
- Org auto-sync interval is configured (X hours per org setup)
- today = 2026-06-16; last_sync_time = known; next_sync_time = last_sync_time + X hours
- A Course Master AutoSync_TC has been created after the last sync ran
- Logged in to the Back Office as HQ Staff
steps_actions:
1. "Confirm AutoSync_TC is NOT visible in BO immediately after creation"
2. "Wait until the next scheduled auto-sync time (last_sync_time + X hours) without clicking Sync Data"
3. "After auto-sync completes, search for AutoSync_TC in BO"
steps_result:
1. "Record is absent from BO"
2. "System runs the auto-sync job automatically at the configured time"
3. "AutoSync_TC is now visible in BO with correct Name, Course Code, and Partner Internal Id"
